art_instructions: Inside the same cozy classroom as earlier, show soft blue walls with wooden beams, large sunlit windows, honey-colored oak desks pushed back to create a play area over a colorful geometric woven rug. A chalkboard in the background still shows big Α, Β, Γ and 1, 2, 3 from the last lesson, with the teacher’s podium and a small blue-and-white pottery vase to one side. Center-left on the rug, Glaux the owl (mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, small green scarf at her neck) leans forward happily, one foot on a small red ball, wings slightly open as she gently rolls the ball toward her classmates. At center-right, two unnamed bird friends play with her: a small sparrow with brown and gray feathers sits cross-legged with wings outstretched to receive the ball, and just behind the sparrow, a blue jay with bright blue feathers kneels with talons ready to catch, both smiling and focused on the ball. Keep the three children roughly the same size and at the same eye level, forming a clear little triangle of play on the rug. Along the wall, include a low shelf with wooden blocks and picture cards; Glaux’s tiny satchel rests beside the rug edge near her. Bright natural light pours in from the windows, casting soft, friendly shadows that emphasize the playful mood.
